hypothesis: Typed current facts show a positive but unstable mean effect in dual fusion. The original controlled coarse-facts experiment favored concat over the product path. Test whether disabling only the product path improves typed forecasting and changes dynamic-fact benefit, without attributing a fusion benefit to language pretraining.
primary_comparisons: concat dynamic vs reused typed dual dynamic
concat usual vs reused typed dual usual

architecture.common: Original four-layer width128/heads4/rank8 dual-gated PaperForecaster. Same numerical inputs/22futureinterface/masks/loss/dropout/optimizer/sampling. Schema only retains existing schema_output.weight128x128 extra16384parameters with forked initializerRNG.

corpus.source: Original frozen TSG complete TEXT_CORPUS.json, not the later difference-text corpus
corpus.instruction: Represent this energy forecasting context, preserving asset identity, observation availability, current operating state, and the direction and magnitude of changes.
corpus.tokenizer: Pinned Qwen3-Embedding-8B tokenizer; same token IDs and official terminal token for both models; no chat template
corpus.pooling: last valid token of final layer, FP32 thenL2

facts.wind: Separatelynamedwind-speed24hmean/1hchange(m/s), recentrelativewinddirection(degrees, noangleaveraging), externaltemperature24hmean(C), recentthreebladepitchmean(degrees). PhysicalvaluesreconstructedfromoriginalinputzusingfrozenoriginalTRAINoffset/scale. No inventedcurtailment/outagecauses.

usual: Per-field lowerTRAINmedian conditioned onoriginalasset/calendar,>=16uniqueorigins andsamepredeclaredbackoff; keep recipientfieldmissingness andallcurrentmetadata/counts/age/availability. NoVAL fitting.
schema: No new schema arms. Round 3 complete schema results remain a stronger-than-token-frequency secondary reference.

training.loss: equal-task TRAIN-mean-absolute-scale masked Huber1 plus1e-4 pre-strength branch energy

selection.metric: complete four-task VAL asset-macro NMAE mean

success.primary: Concat dynamic must improve mean VAL asset-macro NMAE by at least 0.5% over concat usual and over matched typed dual dynamic; at least 3/4 tasks improve NMAE in each comparison. All 16 metrics and interactions reported. Practical signals do not imply statistically independent confirmation.
success.global_reference: Promotion additionally requires beating the historical coarse concat 0.3429642435072586 and numeric-state 0.3480815240676827 references on complete-VAL mean NMAE. A fusion benefit shared by dynamic and usual is not a dynamic fact benefit. No direct language-specific claim from this round.
success.uncertainty: Same-origin paired 7-day circular block, 5000 draws, seed 2027, exploratory after repeated VAL. No TEST or new seed. No empirical results used to select checkpoints beyond the fixed rule.

change: Existing concat_only: c=LayerNorm(W4[SiLU(W1[s,p,v]), 0]); remove only the contribution W2(s) elementwise-times W3(p). Rank and strength gates, numeric backbone, loss, LR, allocated parameters remain unchanged. W2/W3 have no gradients or Adam state.
